manifest.tagline: Pattern matching, CFPC intent routing, CHEESE scoring, and Sheogorath entropy generation

api.note: No standalone HTTP server — atomic keys route through the native driver layer; Sheogorath daemon available on port 3213 (Sheogorath.Daemon.dll)

atomic_keys.description: general micronaut pattern match — routes query through Micronaut.Patterns.dll then Field.Patterns.dll field-category layer; returns top candidate with provenance
CFPC Context Fluency Pattern Creation match — applies neighborhood_resolve with wildcard captures via CFPC.Patterns.dll; returns context_text, question_templates, and field-routed candidate
field-category pattern routing — dispatches to eliza-field categories (⟁GENERAL_QA, ⟁REFLECTION, ⟁CONVERSATION, ⟁KNOWLEDGE, ⟁REASONING, ⟁FALLBACK) via Field.Patterns.dll + eliza-bias.gml
CHEESE reinforcement score for a candidate — Cheese.Critic.dll computes sqrt(novelty × coherence); returns score, novelty, coherence, verdict; candidates below jyggalag_threshold 0.85 are dropped

full Sheogorath entropy expansion → Jyggalag collapse pipeline — Sheogorath.Patterns.dll generates greymarch_set at T=0.97 (Xul); CHEESE filters; Jyggalag collapses to collapsed_candidate; Sheogorath and Jyggalag are a matched pair and must appear as a unit
query audit log for pattern match decisions — Pattern.Log.dll append-only; returns recent log entries by query pattern, phase, or decision outcome
driver load status — reports all seven DLL load states, Sheogorath.Daemon.dll port 3213 availability, and CHEESE balance

xcfe.note: PATTERNS-µ matches, scores, and routes; it does not commit topology or emit responses. greymarch_set is evidence passed to Jyggalag; Greymarch record is not a topology commit.

learning.note: pattern matching is stateless at this layer; pattern audit log is append-only via Pattern.Log.dll

driver_roles.Sheogorath.Patterns.dll: entropy-maximising pattern ops — ENTROPY_EXPAND, TRAJECTORY_DIVERGE, GREYMARCH_GENERATE at T=0.97 Xul phase; produces greymarch_set for Jyggalag COLLAPSE
driver_roles.Sheogorath.Daemon.dll: runtime daemon host for SHEOG-1 on port 3213; boots bots.py; must be running for patterns.greymarch dispatch
driver_roles.Cheese.Critic.dll: CHEESE reinforcement scorer — sqrt(novelty × coherence); filters greymarch_set against jyggalag_threshold 0.85; named in SharedPatternKernelRef of daemon-sheogorath.mml
driver_roles.CFPC.Patterns.dll: Context Fluency Pattern Creation — wildcard captures, neighborhood_resolve (max 1-hop), question_template generation, context_text assembly; phase-anchored per cfpc-pattern.schema.json
driver_roles.Field.Patterns.dll: field-category pattern routing — dispatches through eliza-field categories (⟁GENERAL_QA, ⟁REFLECTION, ⟁CONVERSATION, ⟁KNOWLEDGE, ⟁REASONING, ⟁FALLBACK) using eliza-bias.gml rank weights
driver_roles.Micronaut.Patterns.dll: general micronaut pattern matching substrate — exact-hash then wildcard-specificity lookup; base layer for all other pattern DLLs
driver_roles.Pattern.Log.dll: append-only audit log for pattern match decisions — records query, matched pattern, field category, phase, driver chain, and outcome per turn

pair_constraint.note: Sheogorath (Xul, T=0.97) and Jyggalag (Ch'en, T=0.00) are a matched unit — Sheogorath generates; Jyggalag collapses. patterns.greymarch MUST invoke both. Neither acts alone.
